acceptance_criteria: Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp exists and implements MeterComponent from Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h

Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp paint draws distinct L and R peak/RMS meter bars

stdout:
I have completed Phase G Task G.4 (L/R Peak & RMS Meter Rendering).

### Summary of Changes
- Implemented [Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/aural-maximizer-pro/Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp) strictly matching [Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/aural-maximizer-pro/Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h).
- **Lock-Free Level Transfer**: `setLevels`, `pushLevels`, and getter methods load/store atomic levels using `std::memory_order_relaxed` without any mutexes or memory allocations.
- **Timer Refresh & Decay**: `timerCallback` runs on the message thread at `updateRateHz` (60 Hz cap), snapshots atomic levels, applies exponential decay, and triggers `repaint()`.
- **LED-Style Rendering**: `paint()` renders distinct Left and Right vertical LED segment bars for peak and RMS levels with logarithmic dB scaling (`-60 dB` to `0 dB`), gradient fills, segment dividers, and peak hold ticks matching `CustomLookAndFeel` colors.
- **Verification**: Formatted and verified using `clang-format --dry-run --Werror`. Strictly modified only `Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp`.
